name: Smart Conversion
definition: An advanced, gradient-based voxel-to-mesh conversion algorithm that prioritizes accuracy by correcting errors from noise, multiple materials, or inaccurate iso-values, pulling the mesh to align with the true boundary of the scan.
summary: Smart Conversion is a gradient-based voxel-to-mesh algorithm that iteratively pulls mesh vertices to align with true boundaries, correcting errors from noise or inaccurate iso-values.
